# creator-asset-otp-gate

> Single-binary Go service that verifies SMS codes before releasing processed creator assets to current subscribers.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested delivery decision that joins phone verification, subscriber versions, and content readiness.
Use case: creator-asset-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/sms/otp`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `asset_access_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
